summary:
Iteration 8 end-to-end verified. Backend: 15/15 pytest in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8.py PASS (~8.5s). Covers (a) Detector Feedback — POST FP without reason -> 400; FP with invalid reason -> 400; TP then FP flow returns 201 with detector_version + is_true_positive + user_email; list endpoint returns entries; GET /api/cases/{id}/evidence includes detector_feedback array AND audit_history contains 'detector.feedback'; evidence.pdf 200. (b) GET /api/detector/precision shape has versions[], overall{tp,fp,precision,reviewed,pending_review}, fp_reasons[], weekly[], reasons_catalog, recent[]; TP-then-FP on same case counted once as FP. (c) SSE /api/alerts/stream: invalid token -> 401; opening with analyst JWT emits 'event: hello' immediately, then triggering POST /api/cases/{id}/correlate sync=true produces 'event: alert' + 'event: job' with succeeded state; GET /api/alerts/latest returns {alerts, unacknowledged, server_time}; POST /api/events/test-publish analyst 403, admin 200. (d) Correlation v1.1.0: correlate returns 202 async and result has algorithm_version 'corr-1.1.0', drift_model {version, hours, path, envelope, likely_envelope, likely_window_hours, sigma_km}, gap_fill{enabled:true,version}; candidates have evidence.interpolated_count + gap_segments; params fill_gaps:false -> gap_fill.enabled=false and every candidate has interpolated_count==0; two consecutive runs same params → identical input_hash (reproducibility); GET /api/cases/{id}/geojson features include layers drift_envelope, drift_likely, drift_path and at least one track feature with properties.interpolated=true. (e) Spoof: ingesting 2 AIS fixes 31 min apart, ~55 km apart within corridor for MMSI 886xxxxxx via POST /api/ais/positions then correlate → candidate ais_flags contains 'spoof_suspect', evidence.gap_segments[0].spoof_suspect=true, interpolated_points=0.

Frontend (Playwright on public URL, analyst): login OK; header live-mode reports 'LIVE' (SSE connected); dashboard shows detector-precision-card with detector-precision-value '0%' (all recent verdicts are FP — expected); case SPL-20260610-001 loads with map legend containing 'Interpolated AIS gap' + 'Origin envelope' and 204 svg paths (envelope + dashed gap segments); tab-review reveals detector-feedback panel — clicking feedback-false_positive, selecting reason 'wake' via feedback-reason, submitting via feedback-submit -> detector-feedback-latest badge reads 'false positive · wake · analyst@sentinelmar.demo'; clicking 'Run correlation' triggers a critical-banner (with critical-banner-open + critical-banner-dismiss), live-bell-count becomes '1', dismiss removes banner; regression navigations events (events-count present), explorer (density-window-select present), compare, jobs & alerts all load; evidence.pdf 200 application/pdf. Only console issue is the pre-existing (iteration 7) React hydration warning '<span> option cannot be a child of <span>' — carried over, not introduced in iteration 8.

design_issues.screen: Global (Layout header, carried over from iteration 7)
issues: React hydration warning still present in console: '<span> option cannot be a child of <span>'. Non-blocking but pollutes console on every route change.

action_items: (Carry-over from iter 7) Locate and fix the <option> being rendered inside a <span> that triggers the React hydration warning on every page load.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/live.py detector_feedback: FP without/invalid reason 400 correctly enforced; TP verdict correctly nulls reason on the persisted doc (so subsequent aggregations don't stale-count). Consider indexing db.detector_feedback on {case_id, created_at} for large volumes — current aggregation with $sort+$group scans all docs.

routers/live.py alerts_stream: SSE uses a per-connection asyncio.Queue with 15s keepalive; auth is via ?token= querystring (necessary because EventSource can't set headers) — token is a signed JWT and only decoded via jwt lib, good. Note: token in URL will end up in access logs / browser history — acceptable for short-lived JWTs.

routers/live.py detector_precision: aggregation returns latest verdict per case correctly (sort desc, $first). pending_review count filters on source∈{dark_spot_detector, mock_detector} which matches the seeded detector cases. Consider exposing an /api/detector/precision?version=X drilldown for weekly per-version, currently weekly is aggregate across versions.

correlation.py + drift.py + gapfill.py: algorithm_version 'corr-1.1.0' propagated; deterministic input_hash confirmed (two runs same params -> identical hash); reproducible. Gap-fill correctly synthesizes interpolated fixes when required_speed <= vessel_max_kn (default 45 kn) and gap>threshold; flags spoof_suspect when required_speed>vmax and does NOT synthesize interpolated points (interpolated_points=0). All correct.

cases.py _geojson: drift_envelope / drift_likely / drift_path features included when result.drift_model present; track features split into solid vs dashed segments by properties.interpolated bool — correct for the map dashed-rendering requirement.

Frontend LiveFeed: correctly downgrades to polling when SSE fails; the ‘LIVE’ badge worked immediately after login. Critical-banner shows/dismisses cleanly and increments live-bell-count on new severity=high alerts.

Minor: correlation POST endpoint returns 202 Accepted (async job) even with sync=true — the response body already contains the fully-materialized job/result. Fine, but the API is inconsistent with 200/201 return codes elsewhere; the OpenAPI schema should document 202 explicitly to avoid confusion for clients checking status codes.

seed_data_creation: Left several TEST_ detector_feedback rows on SPL-20260610-001 (TP then FP verdicts across multiple test runs) — these are used by the /api/detector/precision aggregation and shown as the latest FP verdict in the case doc. Ingested TEST_SPOOF AIS positions under time-unique MMSIs (886xxxxxx) — 2 positions per run within the SPL-20260610-001 corridor with impossible transit speed to force spoof_suspect flag. No production data mutated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend suite: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8.py -v -o addopts='' (pytest.ini forces -n2 --dist loadscope; single-file runs need -o addopts=''). BASE_URL is read from /app/frontend/.env. Important gotchas: (1) /api/cases/{id}/correlate returns 202 Accepted with the completed job body inline — treat 202 as success. (2) AIS positions.mmsi is a Pydantic string field — send as str, not int. (3) GET /api/cases/{id}/geojson returns a FeatureCollection (no top-level 'layers' key) — check features[].properties.layer for 'drift_envelope', 'drift_likely', 'drift_path'. (4) To force spoof_suspect via ingest, need gap>30min AND required_speed>vessel_max (~45 kn) AND both fixes within 28 km corridor of spill (53.55, 3.70): 31 min + ~55 km spanning lon 3.28→4.12 works. (5) Watchfiles hot-reload will restart backend when writing to /app/backend/tests/*.py — first pytest run after a file save may hit read-timeouts; wait ~5s and re-run. (6) OCEAN RELAY (MMSI 257000123) does NOT currently have gap segments — the vessel that does is SEA HARVEST (235112233) with interp≈56 across 11 segments. The pre-existing '<span> option cannot be a child of <span>' hydration warning from iteration 7 is still present and unrelated to iteration 8.
